verdict.rationale: Claude Code's own materials say it maps and explains entire codebases, using agentic search to understand project structure and dependencies without manual context selection. That directly addresses understanding how a codebase fits together, and the GitHub README adds that it explains complex code. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the codebase-exploration workflow, explicit support for pinpointing where to start making changes, independent or hands-on corroboration of codebase-mapping quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can understand how a codebase fits together to find where to start making changes

citations.quote: Claude Code maps and explains entire codebases in a few seconds. It uses agentic search to understand project structure and dependencies without you having to manually select context files.
It understands your entire codebase and can work across multiple files and tools to get things done.
